messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

The missing MMSC URL is likely causing your MMS issue. Let's fix that by resetting your APN settings to the default.

Please do the following on your phone:
1. Use `reset_apn_settings()` to reset your APN settings to default.
2. After resetting, use `reboot_device()` to restart your phone completely (this is required for the APN changes to apply).

Once your phone has restarted, please try sending an MMS message again or run `can_send_mms()` to check if it can send MMS now. Let me know the result.

I have reset the APN settings and restarted my phone as instructed. However, I see that my phone is currently in Airplane Mode (there is an airplane icon in the status bar), so I might not be able to send messages until I turn that off. Should I turn off Airplane Mode now and then check if I can send an MMS message?

Please complete the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
